statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnosis code for atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery is I25.10
The diagnosis code for intermittent palpitations is R00.2
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess for ischemic changes in the context of established coronary artery disease
The claim was denied with denial reason code CO-50
The denial was based on the service not being deemed medically necessary under current coverage guidelines
